blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Greetings are the first moment of every conversation. At Czarnikow, a warm "Hello" and "Nice to meet you" open doors. Small words are very important.

Today you will learn five polite expressions. They are easy and you use them every day. You say "Hello", "Please", "Thanks", "Welcome", and "Goodbye". Step by step, you can do it!

English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. When you smile and say "Nice to meet you", people feel welcome. A good greeting is a good start.

items.q: According to the text, what is the first moment of every conversation?
items.why: "Greetings are the first moment of every conversation."

items.q: How many polite expressions will you learn today?
items.why: "Today you will learn five polite expressions."

items.q: What do a warm "Hello" and "Nice to meet you" do?
items.why: "a warm 'Hello' and 'Nice to meet you' open doors."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with the idea that…
options: A good greeting is a good start
Greetings do not matter at work
You can learn step by step
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo diz que pequenas palavras e cumprimentos são importantes.

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that the author wants you to feel…
options: Confident and able to do it
items.why: Inferência: a frase é de incentivo — foco no que você CONSEGUE fazer.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie na recepção da Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! My name is Sophie. Welcome to Czarnikow. It is very nice to meet you today.

I work here at reception. Every morning I say hello to my colleagues. I smile and I say, "Good morning! How are you?" They say, "I am fine, thanks." It is easy and it is kind.

Today two new people start work. I go to the door and I say, "Hello, please come in. Nice to meet you." They are happy. A warm hello is a good start.

Then I help the new people. I show them the office. I say, "This is your desk. Please sit down." They say, "Thanks for your help." I say, "You are welcome."

At the end of the day, I say, "Goodbye, see you tomorrow. Have a nice day!" Small words are important. Hello, please, thanks, and goodbye make people feel welcome. You can do it too!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "I work here at reception."

items.q: What does Sophie say to her colleagues every morning?
items.why: "I smile and I say, 'Good morning! How are you?'"

items.q: What do the new people say when Sophie helps them?
items.why: "They say, 'Thanks for your help.'"

items.q: Sophie smiles and uses kind words. This suggests that she wants people to feel…
items.why: Inferência: sorrir e usar palavras gentis serve para deixar as pessoas bem-vindas.

items.q: From what Sophie says, we can understand that she thinks small words are…
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Small words are important" e usa-as o dia todo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Hello, I am Sophie. How are you?" Hello means…
items.why: Hello = olá, o cumprimento de chegada.

items.q: "It is late. Goodbye, see you tomorrow." Goodbye means…
items.why: Goodbye = tchau, a despedida.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Can you help me, ___?"
items.why: Please = por favor, para pedir com educação.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "You helped me a lot. ___ for your help!"
items.why: Thanks = obrigado(a), para agradecer.

items.q: "Welcome to Czarnikow! Please come in." Welcome means…
items.why: Welcome = bem-vindo(a), para receber alguém.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Hello! Please come in." Come in means…
items.why: Come in = entrar (na sala).

items.q: "This is your desk. Please sit down." Sit down means…
items.why: Sit down = sentar-se.

items.q: "Goodbye! See you tomorrow." See you tomorrow means…
items.why: See you tomorrow = até amanhã, a gente se vê amanhã.

items.q: "How are you today?" A good answer is…
items.why: How are you? = Como você está? A resposta educada é "I am fine, thanks."

items.q: "Goodbye! Have a nice day!" We say this to…
items.why: Have a nice day = tenha um bom dia, uma despedida simpática.
